mainEntity.name: Can AI handle customer support if every response still needs my approval?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use AI to prepare customer-support drafts and route routine questions, but keep a human responsible for unusual, sensitive, angry, or high-impact requests. Run My AI Biz lists first-line support workflows among possible business-operations applications, while its broader approach requires review and approval for consequential actions. Context: A support workflow should identify what information may be used, what the assistant may answer, and when it must stop. A polished response can still be factually wrong or inconsistent with your actual offer and policies. Key factors: - Question complexity. - Customer sensitivity. - Refund or account implications. - Availability of current information. Practical guidance: Create approved answer patterns, require escalation for uncertainty or complaints, and review a sample of completed interactions. Never let a support draft invent policies, promises, credits, or account changes. Run My AI Biz’s educational workflows can help organize the process while keeping the owner in control.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, AI can draft routine replies and organize first-line support, but a human should handle unusual, sensitive, angry, uncertain, refund-related, or account-changing requests. Define approved information, stop rules, and escalation paths. Review samples regularly and prevent invented policies or promises.
